sloka: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा परुषं राक्षसाधिपः ।प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां विप्रियं प्रियदर्शनाम् ।। ५.२०.१।।।।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanaṁ śrutvā paruṣaṁ rākṣasādhipaḥ ।pratyuvāca tataḥ sītāṁ vipriyaṁ priyadarśanām ।। 5.20.1।।।।

translations.english: Ravana expressed his intention in sweet words to the depressed and griefstricken ascetic Sita surrounded by demon guards:
